subject.title: Desktop app should host the Control UI / dashboards natively

question: Should OpenClaw keep this as a focused native dashboard-host tracker, fold it into the broader Linux/Windows companion-app umbrella, or defer it behind desktop security prerequisites?
rationale: The evidence shows partial current support and several overlapping implementation directions, but no single current-main product boundary for WebView hosting, deep links, tray/hotkey behavior, native notifications, packaging, and gateway auth.

options.title: Keep A Focused Dashboard-Native Tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open under the desktop/native track while maintainers choose a platform architecture and require security/package proof for the selected native shell.

options.title: Fold Into Desktop App Umbrella
options.body: Treat the broader Linux/Windows companion-app issue as the only canonical tracker and manage dashboard hosting as one requirement inside that platform program.

options.title: Defer Behind Security Prerequisites
options.body: Pause the dashboard-native work until custom-scheme origin handling, deep-link policy, and native-shell auth boundaries are resolved.

recommendation.title: Keep A Focused Dashboard-Native Tracker
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open under the desktop/native track while maintainers choose a platform architecture and require security/package proof for the selected native shell.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest routing candidate from the broader native-app issue and current macOS dashboard ownership trail.
